items.title: Ming-Image-0.2-Design: open 6B text-to-image model for graphic design, with RGBA layer decomposition
items.excerpt: inclusionAI released Ming-Image-0.2-Design, an MIT-licensed 6B DiT image model aimed at visual design: e-commerce hero images, UI design drafts and spatial renderings, with stronger text rendering, and it can break a design image into editable transparent RGBA layers down to individual characters. Community MLX and ComfyUI quantizations appeared within a day.

items.title: Midjourney Unveils 'Niji V8' Anime Image Generation AI
items.excerpt: Midjourney released Niji V8, its anime-style image model, on November 25 (JST). It follows prompts more closely, returns a wider range of candidates per prompt, and is the fastest Niji model yet. Its editing tools can place a reference character into new scenes or poses while keeping the character consistent.

items.title: Tara Labs launches second-gen 'Short-form Director' that locks storyboards before AI video generation
items.excerpt: Tara Labs' second-generation short-form editor adds a 'Short-form Director' workflow. Creators confirm scene drafts before any video is generated, regenerate only the scenes they want changed, and cut footage by editing the script, which leaves directing control with the creator instead of full automation. The web beta opened to everyone on Nov 26, with free credits.

items.title: Picsart launches Picsart Platform, a single hub for 30+ providers' image and video AI models
items.excerpt: Picsart launched Picsart Platform, a multimodal creative-AI hub that puts more than 250 video, audio, image and text model endpoints from over 30 providers behind one access layer. It targets solo developers, studios and enterprise marketing teams who juggle separate model APIs, and launched with a WAN 3.0 promotion.

items.title: How to Run NVIDIA Cosmos 3 on Local AI Devices Using Hugging Face Diffusers
items.excerpt: NVIDIA showed how to run Cosmos 3 Nano, its world-foundation video-generation model, on consumer GPUs with as little as 12 GB of VRAM. Diffusers group offloading keeps most weights in system RAM and streams them to the GPU as needed. That costs more RAM and speed, so it suits batch generation rather than interactive use.

items.title: Build a 3D game with Claude and Runway MCP (Fluffwing)
items.excerpt: Runway published a reproducible prompt and showcase for Fluffwing, a 3D browser flying game. Claude wrote the code, and Runway MCP generated 14 images, including a style frame and character reference sheets, then turned 11 of them into 3D models that Claude loaded into the game. It shows an agent-driven art-asset pipeline from style frame to in-engine models.

items.title: New One UI 9.5 Recompose gen-AI tool lets you change a photo's perspective after the shot
items.excerpt: A hidden generative-AI 'Recompose' tool in the One UI 9.5 beta Gallery uses a slider to widen or narrow a photo's field of view after capture. It simulates multi-camera or 3D capture without a depth map. The feature is unreleased and may debut with the Galaxy S27. Possible overlap with gadgets.

items.title: Modu Solution shows Gstar3D cloud CAD that builds 3D models from natural language and drawing images
items.excerpt: At SMATEC 2026, Korean CAD/PLM vendor Modu Solution demoed Gstar3D, a cloud 3D CAD tool that creates parametric models, feature history included, from natural-language commands or JPG/PNG drawing images and exports standard formats such as STEP. It is pre-launch, and an early-user program offers up to 100 people a year of free use.

history_match.title: Nomic extends AI agents into CAD drafting and BIM

items.title: SP3D Theia: Automatically Convert 2D Drawings into 3D Models
items.excerpt: SP3D introduced Theia, an AI platform that rebuilds editable 3D models from 2D industrial drawings, including scanned and hand-drawn ones, and outputs SolidWorks and Siemens NX files. Each result is checked against the source drawing, and parts the AI can't reliably build are flagged for an engineer. The story is sourced from a vendor press release.

items.title: Ukrainian senior UI/UX designer launches module.build, an AI editor that keeps the designer in control
items.excerpt: Designer Bohdan Matviyev built module.build, an editor that merges design and development in one canvas. AI acts as an assistant the user controls rather than an autopilot, with Claude, Codex or Kimi plugged in through the user's own subscriptions or APIs. It reads layouts and components straight from design files to make them dev-ready. It is in closed alpha and positioned against Figma and Paper.

items.title: Nexity open-source system enables AI-native websites on Next.js, Sanity
items.excerpt: Nexity is an open-source system for AI-native websites on Next.js and Sanity. Marketing teams create new page sections with AI, and developers review them before they go live, which splits generative page-building from engineering sign-off.

items.title: Carlo Ratti and AI assistant to curate Seoul Biennale of Architecture and Urbanism 2027
items.excerpt: Carlo Ratti will curate the 2027 Seoul Biennale of Architecture and Urbanism with an 'unconventional, AI-based' approach, using an AI assistant to rethink exhibition-making. He teased that 'one assistant curator isn't even human.' The theme and team will be revealed on December 8.

items.title: Adobe's Eric Snowden on How AI Is Changing the Way Designers Work
items.excerpt: In a post-MAX interview, Adobe design VP Eric Snowden gave concrete examples of agent help. An agent lays out a photo grid and checks brand colors while the designer keeps working in the same file, InDesign confirms images are print-ready, and an After Effects agent roughs out an animation and retimes it when the length changes, with keyframe polish left to the designer.

items.title: 'What and why to design': nine global designers answer at Design Korea 2026 conference
items.excerpt: At the Korea Design Promotion Institute's international conference during Design Korea 2026, nine experts, including Vizcom CEO Jordan Taylor and Genesis design executive Song Ji-hyun, discussed how AI is changing the design process. Sessions covered AI-assisted product development and brand identity, and the judgment, taste and perspective designers must keep.

items.title: [Design Korea 2026] Beyond AI to physical AI: design innovation to lift industrial competitiveness
items.excerpt: Design Korea 2026 opened at COEX on Nov 25 under the themes 'Code, Log, Typology, AX', showcasing how Korean firms apply design to AI and robotics products. Design's role is shifting from form to connecting technology and people in real use.

items.title: How Cozey turns its operators into software builders on Vercel
items.excerpt: Furniture retailer Cozey's warehouse, finance and support staff use AI coding agents to build their own internal apps, including a live warehouse floor-plan view and an AI tool that renders Cozey furniture in a customer's room. New apps appear almost weekly next to a custom Next.js storefront for about 1.2 million sofa configurations.

items.title: Crystal Palace fans decimate sloppy AI-generated stadium
items.excerpt: Crystal Palace posted an AI-generated image of Selhurst Park, and fans tore apart its errors. It is the latest example of brand social teams getting caught using unvetted generative imagery and the reputational cost of skipping design review.

items.title: Adobe, Figma and Canva target businesses with AI-powered design tools
items.excerpt: Adobe, Figma and Canva are courting corporate clients with AI design tools built around precision editing and team collaboration, a shift from consumer reach to enterprise design-ops seats. This is a roundup, and the body could not be fetched, so verify the details before carding.

items.excerpt: Jakob Nielsen's UX Tigers channel lays out a timeline for which UX tasks AI can take over and when.
